semantics.meaning: With dir=None, tempfile selects gettempdir() or gettempdirb().
Environment candidate precedence TMPDIR, TEMP, TMP is considered only when discovering the default root; current directory is a last resort.
An explicitly assigned tempfile.tempdir is returned without default-root discovery or an environment lookup.
mkdtemp joins the selected root and generated prefix, audits tempfile.mkdtemp, then calls os.mkdir.
TemporaryDirectory delegates to mkdtemp(suffix, prefix, dir).
semantics.source_excerpt:
def __init__(self, suffix=None, prefix=None, dir=None,
                 ignore_cleanup_errors=False, *, delete=True):
        self.name = mkdtemp(suffix, prefix, dir)
        self._ignore_cleanup_errors = ignore_cleanup_errors
        self._delete = delete
        self._finalizer = _weakref.finalize(
            self, self._cleanup, self.name,
            warn_message="Implicitly cleaning up {!r}".format(self),
            ignore_errors=self._ignore_cleanup_errors, delete=self._delete)
